d: Long, flowing salmon-pink hair is styled with high twin-tails secured by white floral ornaments and characterized by thick, swept bangs. The eyes are a deep ruby red with a soft, gentle expression on a youthful, teenage face. The build is slender, dressed in a pale yellow kimono featuring a red floral motif, layered under a vibrant crimson haori. A blue circular hand fan depicting red koi fish is held in one hand.
